notes: The one-page summary opens on screen first, with Print or save as PDF and Close, instead of going straight to the printer. In My collection, the card names in Price watch open the card's full page. A card with no US price on the free price source no longer swings between its US and European price every week (and price watch no longer alerts on that switch). Value over time no longer shows a meaningless percentage when the first day was worth only a few cents.
